_how_to_read: One item per piece of audio placed in the video. file: path to the take (relative to this file). in/out: seconds inside the take to use (trim the silence and any fluffs). at: second in the final video where it starts. slide: slide name exactly as in beats.md. parts: which parts it covers, e.g. P1 or P1-P3. gain_db: optional level change for this piece (0 = none). Copy this file to placements.json and edit.
